#!/bin/bash
set -Eeuo pipefail

# OpenJDK 21 und Maven kommen als Pakete; Gradle in der aktuellen Version von
# services.gradle.org nach /opt/gradle (das Archiv-Gradle ist zu alt).

install_user="${1:-ubuntu}"
if ! getent passwd "$install_user" >/dev/null; then
    echo "Benutzer '$install_user' fehlt." >&2
    exit 1
fi

current="$(curl -fsSL https://services.gradle.org/versions/current)"
version="$(printf '%s' "$current" | sed -nE 's/.*"version"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"([^"]+)".*/\1/p' | head -n 1)"
url="$(printf '%s' "$current" | sed -nE 's/.*"downloadUrl"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"([^"]+)".*/\1/p' | head -n 1)"
if [[ -z "$version" || -z "$url" ]]; then
    echo "Gradle-Version nicht ermittelbar (services.gradle.org)." >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [[ ! -x "/opt/gradle/gradle-$version/bin/gradle" ]]; then
    archive="$(mktemp)"
    curl -fsSL "$url" -o "$archive"
    install -d /opt/gradle
    unzip -q -o "$archive" -d /opt/gradle
    rm -f "$archive"
fi

ln -sfn "/opt/gradle/gradle-$version/bin/gradle" /usr/local/bin/gradle

sudo -u "$install_user" -H bash -c 'java -version && mvn -v && gradle --version'

install -d /var/lib/corebridge
touch /var/lib/corebridge/java.ready
